blocks.html: As you age, it’s often your face that shows the passage of time the most. Your face greets the world, and you want it to look its best, which is why cosmetic injectables are a great solution for restoring a more vibrant, and less weathered, appearance. The Victory MedSpa offers several cosmetic injectables that erase lines, fill in volume, and reduce the appearance of fat.

The term “Injectables” is a catchall term for several cosmetic treatments administered through injections. At the Victory MedSpa, our specialists offer a full array of the most effective and results-oriented injectables that tackle the effects of aging skin from many angles.
Have a look below at what each of our injectables can do for your skin. See something your skin needs? Schedule an appointment with the MedSpa today by going to our booking page to get started!

One of the more popularly known injections, Botox is approved for treating forehead lines and crow’s feet in addition to glabellar lines (frown lines around your eyebrows). Our treatments are non-invasive, painless, and require little to no recovery time. The number of units that are used on your skin depends on the desired results.

Want to know more about what your skin needs before you schedule an appointment? No problem! Call to schedule a consultation with the Victory MedSpa and they will tell you exactly what you need to know.

Dysport, often used in conjunction with Botox, reduces the appearance of lines that primarily affect the glabella, the area between your eyebrows. These lines extend upward, or vertically, toward the forehead and are most commonly known as “frown lines”. While naturally occurring, aging and collagen loss in the skin can affect these lines to be deeper, more promoninent, and noticable even when your face is relaxed. Our Dysport injection aims to reverse those affects and to give your skin a smooth and relaxed look once again. Our treatments are non-invasive, painless, and require little to no recovery time. The number of units that are used on your skin depends on the desired results.

Want to know more about what your skin needs before you schedule an appointment? No problem! Call to schedule a consultation with the Victory MedSpa and they will tell you exactly what you need to know.

Jeuveau<sup>®</sup> is a prescription medicine, using Hi-Pure™ Technology, that is injected into muscles and used in adults for a short period of time to improve the look of moderate to severe frown lines between the eyebrows.
Jeuveau<sup>®</sup> dosing units are not the same as, or comparable to, any other botulinum.

Juvederm Volux XC is a dermal filler specifically designed to address facial volume loss and sculpt the jawline. It is a hyaluronic acid-based injectable gel produced by Allergan, a leading pharmaceutical company. The key ingredient, hyaluronic acid, is a natural substance found in the skin that helps maintain moisture and elasticity. Juvederm Volux XC is formulated with VYCROSS technology, which ensures a smooth, long-lasting result.

This treatment is minimally invasive, with effects that can last up to 18-24 months, making it a popular choice for individuals seeking facial rejuvenation without undergoing surgery. As with any medical procedure, it’s essential to consult with a qualified practitioner to determine if Juvederm Volux XC is suitable for your aesthetic goals and individual needs.

SkinVive by JUVÉDERM is a gel implant or dermal filler designed for facial enhancement and rejuvenation. Composed primarily of hyaluronic acid, 1,4-butanediol diglycidyl ether (BDDE), and a small amount (0.3%) of the local anesthetic lidocaine, it is administered via injection into specific areas of the face.
SkinVive is commonly used to address facial lines, wrinkles, and to restore youthful contours, providing patients with a non-surgical option for facial rejuvenation.

It’s important to note that the specific composition and indications for dermal fillers like SkinVive may vary, so it’s advisable to consult with a qualified medical professional for personalized guidance and treatment.

Restylane Eyelight is a popular and innovative dermal filler designed specifically for enhancing the appearance of the under-eye area. This product is part of the Restylane family of hyaluronic acid-based fillers, known for their safety and effectiveness. Restylane Eyelight is formulated with a unique blend of hyaluronic acid and other essential ingredients to address common concerns associated with under-eye issues, such as dark circles, fine lines, and hollows.
By providing subtle volume and hydration to the delicate under-eye skin, it can help reduce the appearance of tiredness and improve overall facial rejuvenation.
Its natural-looking results typically last for several months, making it a popular choice for those seeking a quick and effective aesthetic enhancement for their eyes.
